job.name: ig7_host_a
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary-looking woman — not a celebrity, not a model.
job.meaning: женщина ~42, психолог: тёмные волосы в гладком низком пучке, тонкие золотые круглые очки, кремовая шёлковая блузка и пиджак цвета кэмел, светлая тёплая штукатурка, свет из окна; документальное интервью, взгляд вбок
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a woman about 42 years old, a psychologist: dark-brown hair in a sleek low bun, thin gold round glasses, small pearl earrings, a cream silk blouse under a camel blazer. Background: a bare warm light-grey plaster wall, minimalist, a soft diagonal window shadow. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, centred, seen from mid-thigh up while seated on a simple armless chair, generous empty space around her, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, face sharp and detailed (the frame will also be cropped to tight close-ups). Head turned about 25 degrees to the left, eyes looking off-camera to the left as if answering an interviewer — a documentary interview shot. Expression: calm, smart and engaged, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted showing a hint of teeth, NO smile. Hands relaxed in her lap. Look: a candid still from a real high-end documentary interview, cinema camera, 50mm, f/2.8, soft natural window light from the left with a gentle shadow on the wall, natural unretouched skin with pores and fine lines, real hair flyaways. No microphone, no headphones, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

attempts.issue: Subject is not facing front and not looking directly into the camera
Subject must face front and look directly into the camera
